DESCRIPTION: This is a dark-themed admin dashboard for an "AI Platform" that manages various AI providers. The screen displays a grid of provider cards (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Sarvam AI, ElevenLabs) showing their health status, capabilities (Chat, Voice Chat, Realtime Voice), and available model counts. Key UI elements include a top navigation with "Providers & Models" and "Default Assistant" tabs, a sub-navigation for "Chat," "Voice Chat," and "Realtime Voice," and action buttons like "Open provider" and "Configure."

APP: Clara AI Platform
SCREEN: Providers & Models (or Platform Admin - Providers)
